scope: Architecture/source-interface assessment only; no implementation, runtime, operated-capacity or full G07 acceptance.
independentSourceBindings: All ten plan source bindings rehashed equal current lead; inspected actual projection reducer, index load/scan/rollback/query, decoder, server factory/route grammar and reader paging.

sourceFindings.finding: Current load reverses/materializes all ranges, events and undo closures; maxEvents50000/maxRanges20000/64MiB snapshot are real lifetime gates. Existing timed read uses Promise.race then clears busy in finally before underlying ownership necessarily settles.

Existing shared stage reducer has transaction-linked PostPublished/PluginReplyPublished checks and touched-key overlays. Its query paths materialize full orders/maps. Extraction into one closed synchronous keyed port is a reasonable bounded change; copying domain logic into SQL is not.

Slugs are validated ASCII lowercase/digits/hyphen and subboard ID is derived from slug, so exact slug byte ordering can preserve current JS ordering. Text search on name/description must retain JS Unicode trim/lowercase/substring semantics, not SQLite LIKE/NOCASE.

Current reader rejects empty pages with continuation and auto-drains IntersectionObserver plus saved-page replay. Approved directory exception therefore requires explicit later reader changes; server-only change would break UI.

firstSliceRequirements: Keep existing in-memory projection visible semantics and tests; share exactly one original semantic reducer with closed synchronous point get/has/set operations. No trusted boolean bypass of original branded-event checks.

Atomic transaction groups must retain complete actual transaction linkage, including awaiting plugin reply checks and exact event ordering/scope. SQL commit includes events, projection, inverse, coverage/cursor and control CAS or none; lost-return cannot duplicate.

Beforeimages and rollback must handle inserts, updates, false like membership, repeated touched key, scalar policy/order counters and tombstones exactly. In-memory staged apply/undo stale-use and single-use guarantees retained.

SQL schema/indexes may be implemented first, but production factory stays on existing path until ingestion/ownership slice is independently reviewed. No generic storage migration or unrelated consumer change.

SQLite row/byte admission must check lengths before allocating/parsing blobs. Do not make a full-history JSON serialization, COUNT scan, MAX scan, cascade deletion or full array hidden behind a bounded API.
requiredRefinementsBeforeProductionWirin: Name RAM authentication epoch separately from projection revision/view cursor generation: hot append may reuse authenticated state but must invalidate old paging tokens. Publish only one fully reauthenticated canonical generation.

Restart must compare all retained coverage and canonical event rows, including trailing/extra/omitted/empty-block rows, and must never trust persisted ready/projection/control values alone. Partial fresh generation remains unavailable.

Per-transaction row/byte bound must be derived from pinned protocol event/payload limits before asserting complete legitimate-history ingestion; no arbitrary guard may reject a valid single transaction. Dense full-body transport gap remains separate explicit blocker.

Every Home/directory query needs aggregate materialization-byte bound, not only257*101 row count. Prefer rank-key-only bounded merge and then fetch page-associated payloads. A row LIMIT or EXPLAIN plan alone does not prove bounded visited work; use real SQLite API capabilities or honest measurable alternatives.

Use short snapshot reads and actual single-owner/CAS generation guards; data_version is only a concurrent-change signal, never event authenticity. No await inside SQL transaction and no clearing ownership while started reads/commits still run.

Directory cursor is last examined row with no skipped unreturned match; empty nonterminal means canonical complete but search unfinished. One explicit action/window, no automatic draining or unbounded restoration; private following/bookmark/subscription state remains client-side.
Bounded GC/checkpoint/rollback and disk-full failure preserve all canonical history; no eviction, bulk foreground DELETE/VACUUM or silent lifetime cap.
acceptance: All current pure projection assertions and differential SQL equivalence for all event types, policy/history/moderation/avatar/plugin linkage, unsigned ordering, rank/cursors.
Real SQLite atomic crash/lost-reply and cross-process conflict tests, not mocked commits.
Same-scope history beyond all three old caps; bounded working set and query work with declared measurement limits; distinguish synthetic volume from actual authenticated ingestion.
Deep reorg beyond128 and20k retained segments in bounded steps, no ready views during reconciliation, complete original-decoder rebuild after cache tampering/loss.
Privacy trace equality, exact public route grammar, no server private lists. Actual operated complete-history/dense-valid-wire acceptance remains mandatory separately.
